cozy-christmas-party-games.name: Cozy Christmas Party Games
cozy-christmas-party-games.html:
Make your Christmas party merry and bright with this cute printable party games bundle! Eight easy games for kids, families and grown-ups in one download: picture bingo, trivia, two scavenger hunts, charades and a drawing game, a pass-the-present story and more. Pastel colors and smiling little reindeer, gingerbread men and penguins on every page, to match my Cozy Christmas dinner party kit.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (32 printable pages)

- Cover and a welcome page: which games suit kids, families and grown-ups, how to set up, and printing tips

- Christmas picture bingo: 30 different cards, 2 per page. Each card has 24 cute pictures with their names and a free space, so little ones who can't read yet can play too

- 30 bingo calling cards, plus a caller's page with how to play, 5 ways to win and a checklist for 3 games

- Christmas trivia: 40 multiple-choice questions in two rounds (an easier family round and a harder round), a tiebreaker and an answer key. Topics: traditions around the world, history, food, nature and science, carols, and the Christmas story from Luke 2 and Matthew 2 (King James Version)

- Christmas picture hunt: 20 things for little ones to find around the house

- Rhyming clue hunt: 10 clue cards that lead from spot to spot around the house, a grown-up's hiding key that uses safe spots only, and 4 blank cards for your own clues

- The pointing game: 24 "Who would...?" cards. Everyone points at who fits best!

- Pick one!: 24 Christmas choice cards, like "Build a snowman or have a snowball fight?"

- Act it or draw it: 48 charades and drawing game words, marked easy, medium and hard

- Pass the present: an original Christmas story full of LEFT and RIGHT for passing a gift around the circle, with the rules

- Score sheet

HOW IT WORKS

1. Download your files once your payment is confirmed.

2. Print at home or at a print shop. Cardstock is best for the bingo and calling cards.

3. Cut the cards apart and let the games begin!

PLEASE NOTE

- This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.

- 2 PDF files, US Letter and A4. The files are not editable; fill them in by hand.

- For personal use only: your own family, parties, classroom or church group. Print as many copies as you like, but please don't share or resell the files.

- Colors may look a little different on screen and in print.

- Every trivia answer was checked against trusted sources such as the King James Bible, the Smithsonian, the Library of Congress, the National Park Service and NOAA.

MORE FROM MY SHOP

Pairs well with my Cozy Christmas Supper Club Kit for a dinner party with games.

cozy-medical-binder.name: Cozy Medical Binder
cozy-medical-binder.html:
Keep your whole health story in one cozy place. This printable medical binder holds your medicines, doctors, appointments, test results and health history, so you're ready for every doctor visit, for a caregiver who's helping out, and for an emergency. Pastel colors and smiling little pill bottles, hearts and teddy bears make a big job feel a little lighter.

FREE BONUS: your download also includes my printable Daily Planner (10 undated pages: daily pages, weekly and monthly planners, a habit tracker, goals and notes), in US Letter and A4.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (24 printable pages)

- Cover

- How to use it, with printing tips (a wide left margin leaves room for a 3-hole punch)

- Emergency medical information: one page a paramedic or ER can read fast (allergies, conditions, medicines, implants and devices, emergency contacts, doctor, preferred hospital, insurance, where your advance directive is kept)

- Personal and insurance information, with a space to tape copies of your cards

- Doctors and specialists directory (8 entries)

- Current medication list (medicine, strength and dose, how often, what it's for, prescriber, start date, notes)

- Weekly medication schedule: morning, midday, evening and bedtime checkboxes for all 7 days

- Medication change log (started, stopped or changed, why and by whom)

- Allergies and reactions: medicines, foods and other

- Health conditions history

- Surgeries, procedures and hospital stays

- Family health history

- Vaccination record

- Before my appointment: questions for your doctor and what to bring

- Appointment notes: what the doctor said, tests ordered, next steps and follow-up date

- Appointment log

- Symptom tracker (rate it 0 to 10)

- Blood pressure log

- Blood sugar log (before and after meals, and bedtime)

- Lab and test results log

- Caregiver notes: a hand-off page for daily notes, changes noticed, questions for the doctor and visitors

- Helpful numbers: 911, Poison Help and the 988 Lifeline, plus blank lines for your doctor's after-hours line, pharmacy and insurance nurse line

- Wallet emergency cards: 4 fold-over cards, credit-card size (3.375 x 2.125 in), front and back

- Notes page

HOW IT WORKS

1. Download your 4 PDF files once your payment is confirmed.

2. Print at home or at a print shop. US Letter and A4 are both included.

3. Punch the holes, fill it in by hand and keep it in a binder. Print more logs and appointment pages whenever you need them.

PLEASE NOTE

- This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.

- You get 4 PDF files: the Cozy Medical Binder (24 pages) and the bonus Daily Planner (10 pages), each in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4.

- Fill it in by hand (the files are not editable).

- Colors may look a little different on screen and in print.

- For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the files.

- Not medical advice. This binder helps you organize your own health information. Always follow your doctor's and pharmacist's instructions. In an emergency, call 911.

box-truck-conversion-plans.name: Box Truck Conversion Plans
box-truck-conversion-plans.html:
Plan your box truck camper before you buy a single board. This printable planning course takes you from shopping for the right truck to the order you build in, with three dimensioned starting layouts for 12, 16 and 20 ft boxes and 14 fill-in worksheets.

WHAT YOU GET (instant download, US Letter and A4)

- Course guide, 23 pages, 10 modules: pick the right truck, measure everything, weight and payload, layout rules, the three layouts, prep the shell, insulate and seal, systems (power, water, heat, propane and fire safety), legal and paperwork, and build order. Plus a glossary.

- Layouts and dimensions, 8 plan sheets in a blueprint version and a print-friendly version:

00 Cover and sheet index

A-101 BT-12 The Scout: floor plan and schedule

A-102 BT-16 The Nomad: floor plan and schedule

A-103 BT-20 The Hauler: floor plan and schedule

A-201 Typical sections: counter, table, seat and bed heights

A-301 Wall, floor and ceiling build-up

A-401 Weight zones and axle loads

A-501 Roof plans with fans and solar area

- Worksheets and checklists, 14 pages: truck inspection, measurements, weight ratings and scale tickets, weight budget, power budget, water budget, layout priorities, zone grids for 12, 16 and 20 ft, systems and safety, build sequence, budget tracker, and legal and paperwork.

THE THREE LAYOUTS

- BT-12 The Scout: full bed across the front, galley, wet bath, two benches and a drop-in table. Solo or a couple.

- BT-16 The Nomad: RV short queen, wet bath, wardrobe and pantry, galley, and a dinette that drops to a guest bed. A couple, full-time.

- BT-20 The Hauler: queen bed, utility closet, wet bath, long galley, sofa bed, desk and gear locker.

Every item is tagged and sized in inches and millimeters, with the zones, aisles and heavy zone marked.

GOOD TO KNOW

- This is a planning course with concept layouts. It is not engineered, certified or construction drawings.

- Sizes are examples from typical trucks. Measure your own truck and check every dimension before you cut.

- Structure, electrical, plumbing, heaters and propane need qualified help and the codes that apply where you live.

- You get two ZIP files: one in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and one in A4. Each holds the guide, both versions of the plan sheets and the worksheets. Most phones and computers open ZIP files.

- Digital download: nothing is shipped.

- For personal use. Please don't resell or share the files.

Questions or a problem with a file? Send me a message and I'll make it right.

Daniel, Scoop & Dude
